cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Take the Consequence
cards.instruction: Get them to accept responsibility for carrying out the cost, penalty, or unpleasant next step.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your plan cost more. You agreed to announce the budget cut; bring me your opening sentence before the meeting.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It only cost slightly more. Can't we skip the announcement?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No. You may keep the announcement short. Name the cut and the reason, and I'll check the figures.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You could explain it better. Will you do the talking if I stand beside you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll check your explanation with you beforehand. At the meeting you speak; I'll stand beside you and hold the figures. You can point to them, but I won't become the announcement you promised.

reason: Let A refuse B explicit exemption and substitution requests while offering concrete support that preserves B delivery duty, avoiding an arbitrary promotion or abandoning B to perform alone.
